chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 — No Stimulus (3 points) — Set 1: Industrialization
chunks.content: AP European History SAQ 4 (No Stimulus), 3 points, one per part. Set 1 prompts: A [1] describe one significant feature of industrialization in Europe 1750–1800; B [1] describe one significant change in industrialization 1800–1900; C [1] explain one way industrialization affected European politics in 1800–1900. 'Describe' = relevant characteristics; 'Explain' = how/why. Common failure: A giving a post-1800 feature for the 1750–1800 window (chronology); C describing a political outcome without the causal how.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4A, 3/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 3/3 (A 1, B 1, C 1). Described an early-industrialization feature, a 19th-century change, and explained a political effect of industrialization. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4B, 2/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 2/3 (A 0, B 1, C 1). Earned B (a 19th-century change) and C (a political effect) but lost A — the feature given did not fit the 1750–1800 window (a chronology error). Illustrates how a period mismatch costs the Describe point even when later parts succeed.

chunks.subject: AP European History
chunks.title: SAQ 4 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/3
chunks.content: SAQ 4 (Set 1) scored 1/3 (A 0, B 1, C 0). Earned only B (a change in industrialization). Lost A (period mismatch or vague feature) and C (no explained political effect). Illustrates a response holding only the middle 'change' part.
